content:
After an unusual three-week wait, Apple today released iOS 27 beta 5, bringing fresh icons to a range of apps including Siri and Safari.

Apple rolls out app icon updates in iOS 27 beta 5

iOS 27 is getting closer to public release, expected next month.

Today's beta 5 includes a number of user-facing changes ahead of the official launch.

Among them, several system apps have received new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of the new icons in the images above. Other apps have also received very minor updates.

Since the first beta, iOS 27 has introduced further icon design changes, as Apple continues refining last year's Liquid Glass style.

Apps like Maps, Photos, and Wallet have already adopted new icons since iOS 27 began testing. But today's beta 5 revisions suggest Apple hasn't finished tweaking the iOS 27 icons.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
